Game Overview

Go Santa Go puts players into a arcade experience centered on dodge traffic and collect scattered presents as Santa in this exhilarating run through busy city streets. With simple controls and increasing speed, challenge your reflexes in a festive rush to save Christmas. It's a holiday marathon of fun and endurance, captivating for all ages.

How to Play

Go Santa Go keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Dodge traffic and collect scattered presents as Santa in this exhilarating run through busy city streets. With simple controls and increasing speed, challenge your reflexes in a festive rush to save Christmas. It's a holiday marathon of fun and endurance, captivating for all ages.
